title: The Spread Spire
subject: Math: Mean absolute deviation
intro: Climb the Spire in six stages. Each one shows you a method, then hands it to you. Before each stage, pick your path: the Camp shows help, the Lair pays more gold.

contexts.intro: Two frogs each made five jumps, measured in centimetres.
contexts.pickIntro: The frog coach wants a jumping team that jumps far, and jumps about the same every time.

contexts.intro: Two archers each shot five rounds; these are their points.
contexts.pickIntro: The castle wants an archery squad that scores high, and scores about the same every round.

contexts.intro: Miners counted the gems they dug from five tunnels each.
contexts.pickIntro: The dwarf king wants a crew that digs up many gems, and about the same number from every tunnel.

contexts.intro: Two dragons each flew five trips; these are the kilometres flown.
contexts.pickIntro: The queen wants a dragon flight that flies far, and about the same distance every trip.
